data.title: Rebuilding Postgres for 300x faster analytics: batching, operator fusion, and SIMD - malisper.me
data.description: Last week we released version 0.2 of pgrust. This release was all about performance. It’s 10x faster than the previous version of pgrust. On OLTP benchmarks, pgrust is 30% faster than Postgres, and on Clickbench, Clickhouse’s benchmark for analytical databases, pgrust is 300x faster than Postgres. It’s even ahead of Clickhouse!
